definitions.explanation: The vacation period during winter, typically from late December to early January for schools, and around the New Year period for workplaces.

examples.japanese: {冬休|ふゆやす}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
{冬休|ふゆやす}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: I plan to travel with my family during winter break.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冬休|ふゆやす}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{終|お}わらせて⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The children still haven't finished their winter break homework.

notes:
The vacation period during winter, typically from late December to early January.

FORMS:
⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧ (winter) + ⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧ (break/holiday)

CULTURAL NOTE:
School {冬休|ふゆやす}み typically runs about two weeks (late December to early January), much shorter than ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧. It overlaps with ⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧ (year-end and New Year period), the most important holiday season in Japan.

SEASONAL BREAK SET:
- ⟦{春休|はるやす}み→春休み：19115_haruyasumi⟧: spring break (late March to early April)
- ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧: summer vacation (late July to late August, longest)
- {冬休|ふゆやす}み: winter break (late December to early January)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {冬休|ふゆやす}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧: winter break homework
- {冬休|ふゆやす}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter winter break
